module: Registry of the screenshot creator's framing modes. It collects the modes by broadcasting the onScreenshotCreatorCollectFramingModes hook (each mode is a table {id, label, order, resolve, ...}), keeps the chosen mode (default "procedural") and delegates the camera computation to mode.resolve(context). It serializes the chosen mode to survive extension reloads.
notes: A mode is kept only if it is a table with a non-empty string id, a resolve function and a unique id; modes are sorted by order (missing = last) then by id.
Modes are recollected (hook broadcast) on every call to list, getSelected, set or resolve: no cache.
If the chosen mode no longer exists, getSelected falls back to "procedural".
list/get/set/getSelected/setSelected/listModes/getSelectedModeId/setSelectedModeId are aliases of the same functions; migrateLegacyState is an alias of deserialize.
deserialize accepts an old format: skipCustomCameras == false gives "configured", otherwise "procedural".

list.desc: Returns the sorted list of valid framing modes collected by the hook. Alias: listModes.

getSelected.desc: Returns the id of the selected mode ("procedural" if the stored mode no longer exists). Aliases: get, getSelectedModeId.

setSelected.desc: Selects the framing mode by its id. Aliases: set, setSelectedModeId.

returns.desc: true if the mode was selected.

resolve.desc: Computes the framing camera with the given mode (or the selected mode). resolve(context) can be called with modeId omitted: if the first argument is a table and the second is nil, it is taken as the context.

modeId.desc: Mode id, or the context directly.

context.desc: Framing context passed to mode.resolve (vehicle, resolution, fov…).

returns.desc: Error: unknown mode or context that is not a table.

serialize.desc: Returns the state to save: {selectedModeId = ...}. Alias of onSerialize.

deserialize.desc: Restores the selected mode from a saved state (keys selectedModeId, framingModeId or old skipCustomCameras); falls back to "procedural" if invalid. Aliases: migrateLegacyState, onDeserialized.

migrateLegacyState.desc: Alias of deserialize (migration of old states).

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook before extension reload; identical to serialize.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after reload with the serialized state; identical to deserialize.
